say:5:1220342002:0.text: Hey, don't be angry. We came to return something to you.
say:5:1220342002:0.source_cn: 先别生气，我们捡到了你的东西，专门来还给你。

say:6:1220342003:1.text: Is this coin yours? Take a look.

say:7:1220342004:0.text: ... Why do you have it? Where did you find it?

say:8:1220342005:1.text: We found it when we were checking for rats in the sewers.
say:8:1220342005:1.source_cn: 我们在下水道查老鼠的时候找到的。

say:9:1220342006:0.text: This thing's been lost for a while... I can't believe you found it.
say:9:1220342006:0.source_cn: 这东西丢了好一阵子……竟然还能从下水道找见。
say:9:1220342006:0.male: This thing's been lost for a while... I can't believe you found it.
say:9:1220342006:0.female: This thing's been lost for a while... I can't believe you found it.

say:11:1220342008:0.text: When we found it, someone else said it was hers and that you gave her the coin.
say:11:1220342008:0.source_cn: 我们得到它的时候，对方说，这可是你送给她的呢。

say:12:1220342009:0.text: What? No! How could I possibly give away something so important?
say:12:1220342009:0.source_cn: 不是！这么重要的东西，我怎么可能送给别人？

say:13:1220342010:0.text: It seems like you and that girl know each other. Just tell us what happened.

say:20:1220342016:1.text: The kid's got burns all over her body and always has her face covered.
say:20:1220342016:1.source_cn: 那孩子半个身子都是烧伤……总是遮着脸。

say:22:1220342018:1.text: Yeah, that day, she was standing in the street staring at a batch of freshly baked sea biscuits. There was a puddle of drool at her feet.
say:22:1220342018:1.source_cn: 是的。那天她站在街边，看着刚出炉的海盐面包，口水都快滴...

say:23:1220342019:1.text: I happened to receive my salary the day before. Not much, mind you, but enough to buy a few biscuits, so I got her one.
say:23:1220342019:1.source_cn: 正好我前一天拿了薪水，不多，但足够买面包，我就给那小姑娘了。

say:25:1220342021:1.text: Well, I'm as kind as the next scallywag in Rustport. It's just... my daughter also loves sea biscuits.
say:25:1220342021:1.source_cn: 哼，我可不是什么好心人。只是……我女儿，她也很喜欢吃海...

say:26:1220342022:1.text: In the end, it's my fault, really. I wanted to give her a few coins and gave away the coin from the Whispers. I think I'm going blind at my age.
say:26:1220342022:1.source_cn: 结果，都怪我这半瞎的眼睛，给钱的时候，我把血薇帮的那枚...
